name: Assembly Inspection
description: Defect detection and OK/NG judgement on the camera itself. Each frame is letterboxed to 640x640 and run through YOLOX-tiny on the RV1126B NPU, trained on DeepPCB (MIT) for six bare-board defect classes: open, short, mousebite, spur, copper and pin-hole. Boxes above the frozen score become defects, the verdict engine turns them into one OK or NG per frame, and the same verdict leaves the device three ways at once: an MQTT record on inspection/{stream_id}/results validated against the project contract, a Modbus TCP register block a PLC can read (holding registers 0-11 written atomically before coil 0/1 flips, so a PLC that sees the coil already has the matching data), and a loopback HTTP panel with /healthz and /metrics. The detection, judgement and output code is the same core this project runs on Jetson Orin (TensorRT) and Raspberry Pi 5 (Hailo-8) -- only the frame source and the NPU backend differ. Measured on the 205-image DeepPCB validation split on this device: mAP50 0.9870 against 0.9876 for the fp32 CPU reference, 30.9 ms median inference.
description_zh: 缺陷检测与 OK/NG 判定在摄像头上完成。每一帧 letterbox 到 640x640，由 YOLOX-tiny 在 RV1126B NPU 上推理，模型在 DeepPCB（MIT 许可）上训练，覆盖六个裸板缺陷类：断路、短路、鼠咬、毛刺、余铜、漏孔。高于冻结阈值的框计为缺陷，判定引擎按帧给出 OK 或 NG，同一个判定同时从三条出口离开设备：inspection/{stream_id}/results 上的 MQTT 记录（按本项目契约校验）、PLC 可读的 Modbus TCP 寄存器块（保持寄存器 0-11 先原子写入，再翻转线圈 0/1，PLC 看到线圈时数据已经就位）、以及带 /healthz 与 /metrics 的回环 HTTP 面板。检测、判定与出口代码与本项目在 Jetson Orin（TensorRT）、树莓派 5（Hailo-8）上跑的是同一份 core，只有取帧口与 NPU 后端不同。在本设备上用 DeepPCB 验证集 205 张实测：mAP50 0.9870，fp32 CPU 参考为 0.9876，推理时延中位数 30.9 ms。
author: Seeed edge-inspection-assembly

items.title: Stream ID
items.help: Stable identifier for this camera. It goes into every event payload and into the default topic, so several devices publishing to one broker stay separable. Consumers must read it from the payload, never parse it out of the topic.
items.help_zh: 这台相机的稳定标识。它会进每一条事件的 payload，也会进默认 topic，多台设备发到同一个 broker 才分得开。消费方必须从 payload 里读它，不要去解析 topic。

items.title: Frozen defect score
items.help: A box below this score is not counted as a defect. This is the number the published precision and recall are quoted at; the repository evaluation freezes it at 0.35.
items.help_zh: 低于这个分数的框不计为缺陷。对外报的精确率/召回率就是在这个阈值下算的，仓库的评测把它冻结在 0.35。

items.title: Defects for NG
items.help: How many defects in one frame make that frame NG. 1 means any single defect fails the board.
items.help_zh: 一帧里出现多少个缺陷才判 NG。填 1 表示只要有一个缺陷这块板就不合格。

items.title: Debounce frames
items.help: How many consecutive NG frames are required before the verdict flips to NG. 1 reacts fastest; raising it suppresses single-frame noise at the cost of latency.
items.help_zh: 连续多少帧判 NG 才真的翻成 NG。填 1 反应最快；调高可以压掉单帧噪声，代价是判定延迟。

items.title: Inference rate limit (fps)
items.help: Upper bound on how often a captured frame reaches the NPU. The camera keeps supplying frames; this caps the inference rate so the rest of the device keeps its CPU.
items.help_zh: 每秒最多把多少帧送进 NPU。相机照常出帧，这一项限的是推理速率，把 CPU 留给设备上的其它服务。

items.title: Broker address
items.help: Leave empty to watch results only on this device. This camera ships no broker of its own, so an address is what turns verdicts into something another system can consume.
items.help_zh: 留空就只在设备上看结果。这台相机不自带 broker，填了地址判定才会发到别的系统。

items.title: Result topic
items.help: Topic template; {stream_id} is substituted at publish time. Empty means inspection/{stream_id}/results.
items.help_zh: topic 模板，发布时替换 {stream_id}。留空即 inspection/{stream_id}/results。

items.title: Serve Modbus TCP
items.help: Expose the verdict as Modbus TCP holding registers and coils so a PLC can read it without a broker. Register map is in the project's contracts/MODBUS.md: HR 0-11 carry the verdict, counts and heartbeat, coil 0 is OK and coil 1 is NG.
items.help_zh: 把判定以 Modbus TCP 的保持寄存器与线圈暴露出去，PLC 不需要 broker 也能读。寄存器表见项目的 contracts/MODBUS.md：HR 0-11 是判定、计数与心跳，线圈 0 是 OK、线圈 1 是 NG。

items.title: Modbus port
items.help: 502 is the registered Modbus TCP port. The app runs as root, so a port below 1024 binds.
items.help_zh: 502 是 Modbus TCP 的标准端口。应用以 root 运行，1024 以下的端口能绑上。

items.title: Model file
items.help: By default the app uses its bundled .rknn under the installed app's models/ directory. Set this only when you explicitly want a different existing model file.
items.help_zh: 默认使用应用安装目录 models/ 下随包提供的 .rknn。只有明确要使用设备上的其他已有模型文件时才填写此项。

items.title: Frame source
items.help: RTSP substream the detector reads, decoded by an ffmpeg subprocess. live/1 is the 640x480 substream; live/0 is 4K, whose decode cost buys nothing for a 640x640 network input. The device's own OpenCV has no RTSP backend and go2rtc's JPEG snapshot endpoint re-transcodes on every request, so neither is used here.
items.help_zh: 检测读的 RTSP 子码流，由 ffmpeg 子进程解码。live/1 是 640x480 子码流；live/0 是 4K，网络输入只有 640x640，解 4K 没有收益。设备自带的 OpenCV 没有 RTSP 后端，go2rtc 的 JPEG 快照端点每次请求都重新转码，两者都不走。

items.title: Expected-parts file
items.help: Optional path to a JSON file holding the assembly (expected parts + ROI) and dimension sections, in the shape of contracts/config.schema.json. Empty means detection and OK/NG only, with missing-part comparison and dimension measurement off. Those two need per-station ROIs that no generic form can hold.
items.help_zh: 可选。指向一个 JSON 文件，内含 assembly（应有件与 ROI）与 dimension 两段，形状按 contracts/config.schema.json。留空即只做检测与 OK/NG 判定，不做缺件比对与尺寸测量——这两项要按工位标注 ROI，通用表单填不了。

items.title: Status port
items.help: Loopback-only HTTP panel: /healthz and /metrics report source, verdict and publish counters. 0 disables it. The supervisor does not restart a crashed app, so 'the process is alive' is not the same as 'verdicts are still going out'.
items.help_zh: 只绑回环的 HTTP 面板：/healthz 与 /metrics 报采集、判定与发布计数。填 0 关闭。supervisor 不会自动重启崩溃的应用，所以「进程还活着」并不等于「判定还在发」。
